## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Valencia, Spain. It starts at Av. del Professor López Piñero, 3.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> See jaw-dropping IMAX films on a 900m2 dome screen at Hemisfèric, Spain's largest theater hall. Located in the City of Arts and Sciences ("Ciudad de las artes y las ciencias") complex, you'll also get starry-eyed in the enormous domed planetarium and much more besides! Skip the line and jump right into the AV adventure.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €10.36. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 84 ratings and 49 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
